name: Union member in an entity with a union: dues hit their cap
source: synthetic — replace with anonymised real cases
derivation: Base and insurance salary 40,000,000, two dependents, a full month, and the entity's policy has the union switched on.
Member dues are 1% of the contribution base = 400,000, but they are capped at the seeded share of the reference level: 10% x 2,530,000 = 253,000. The cap bites, so dues = 253,000.
The employer's union fund is 2% of the same base = 800,000, and it is owed whether or not the person is a member.
PIT: union dues are a deduction from pay but not from taxable income. Assessable = 40,000,000 - 4,200,000 - 15,500,000 - (2 x 6,200,000 = 12,400,000) = 7,900,000; tax = 5% = 395,000.
